## Forum Energy Technologies to Present at EnerCom Denver – The Energy Investment Conference


August 12, 2026


[PDF Version](https://ir.f-e-t.com/node/15496/pdf)


HOUSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Aug. 12, 2026-- Forum Energy Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: FET) announced today that Lyle Williams, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, will present at the EnerCom Denver – The Energy Investment Conference on Tuesday, August 18, 2026 at 9:40 a.m. Mountain Time.


The presentation can be accessed live at the following link:


[https://enercomdenver.com/webcast/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Furl.us.m.mimecastprotect.com%2Fs%2F4A20COYRPqi4ZAAxU5uzfGq7eW%3Fdomain%3Denercomdenver.com%2F&esheet=54588108&newsitemid=20260812136606&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fenercomdenver.com%2Fwebcast%2F&index=1&md5=22ef303cd9a1d755e7a5b3e0f51e1441)


A link to the live webcast and the presentation slides will be available on the morning of the presentation on FET’s Investor Relations web page at[ir.f-e-t.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.f-e-t.com%2F&esheet=54588108&newsitemid=20260812136606&lan=en-US&anchor=ir.f-e-t.com&index=2&md5=fa346a0e073d1c421932291486c705e9) . A live webcast of the presentation will also be available on the conference website at[www.enercomdenver.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.enercomdenver.com&esheet=54588108&newsitemid=20260812136606&lan=en-US&anchor=www.enercomdenver.com&index=3&md5=da9551b615f3c25bfb6b735768cea4bd) .


*FET® is a global manufacturing company, serving the oil, natural gas, defense, and renewable energy industries. With headquarters located in Houston, Texas, FET provides value-added solutions aimed at improving the safety, efficiency, and environmental impact of our customers' operations. For more information, please visit[www.f-e-t.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.f-e-t.com&esheet=54588108&newsitemid=20260812136606&lan=en-US&anchor=www.f-e-t.com&index=4&md5=8a759d1c8f0e686ce32f19cfb9c1d465) .*
